thread:
Morgan: Heads-up — seeing a spike in pod evictions in ap-south1 over the last 20m. Warmpool attach failures + brief NotReady flips, scheduler ends up rescheduling and we get binpack churn. Eviction rate ~4x baseline.
Kevin: Got a link to events/logs?
Morgan: quick events snippet: `kubectl -n mlapps get events --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -n 12`
Morgan: `Warning  FailedAttachVolume  2m (x9 over 18m)  attachdetach-controller  attach failed: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded`
SRE-bot: alert: evictions-high firing for cluster/ap-south1 (6m) — firingCount=3
Anya: Kubelet logs show repeated `attach timeout: device not responding` and intermittent `NetworkUnavailable` right before the taint. Looks driver/host-level, not scheduler itself.
Kevin: That explains the churn — node flips NotReady -> scheduler backs off then pads elsewhere. Leads to tiny pods scattering and fragmentation. Our existing `avoid-evict-on-nodeflip` grace is 10s.
Jessica: FYI churn = extra Dedicated GPU-hours. Rough calc: 12% uplifts last 6h across that region. Need to weigh quick fix vs cost.
Ops-automation-bot: I can apply a temporary scheduler softening: lower preempt-score, extend node-failure grace. Proposed patch: `kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -n kube-system --type merge -p '{"data":{"nodeFlipGrace":"30s","preemptScoreScale":"0.5"}}'`
Anya: Prefer to first increase kubelet `attachTimeout` on the warmpool nodes (canary) to 45s and enable `delayed-taint-lift` so scheduler doesn't evict immediately on transient net blips.
Morgan: Plan suggestion: 1) Canary kubelet attachTimeout=45s on nodepool-warmpool-canary-a, 2) apply scheduler softening to canary only, 3) monitor evictions + placement skew + cost for 30m, 4) roll to remaining warmpools if stable.
Kevin: On it. Patching kubelet config for canary now: `kubectl patch cm warmpool-canary-kubelet -n infra --patch '{"data":{"attachTimeout":"45s"}}'`
SRE-bot: Deploybot: kubelet config patched for nodepool-warmpool-canary-a — rollout triggered.
Morgan: Watching metrics. After ~7m the canary shows evictions down 60% vs baseline :thumbsup:
Jessica: Nice. If that holds, let's expand to ap-southeast1 canary next, and then write a runbook entry (cost impact, root cause: attach/driver flakiness).
Anya: Postmortem checklist item: investigate NIC driver firmware and host attach path. Also add a scheduler test to simulate node NotReady short flaps so we don't immediately binpack tiny pods.
Kevin: I'll schedule the expand in 15m if canary stays quiet. Assigning to myself.
Ops-automation-bot: Temporary scheduler config (canary) applied. Will auto-revert in 2h unless confirmed.
Morgan: Good call. Once expanded and stable we'll open a follow-up for driver/firmware ops. Thanks all.
Jessica: Add cost Delta tracking to the follow-up.
Kevin: updating incident doc and tagging infra-costs.
SRE-bot: alert: evictions-high cleared for cluster/ap-south1 (now resolved in canary).
